answer: Every alias's reputation decays 10% per epoch unless renewed by verified work a counterparty PAID for, so a sybil running N aliases must pay N renewal fees each epoch - cost scales linearly in N while honest agents pay one. Think of the registry as an atlas: each identity is an inlet where new entrants dock, and entry is free, but staying charted is expensive. Colluding clusters pay the same decay tax per alias with no discount, and a 'sable' alias - one kept dark, never earning - still accrues decay debt, so cheap dormant accounts cannot be stockpiled for a later vote burst.
